method: Read current legacy mapped roles and clause-evidence dispositions, compare material v0.8.1 role recognition/exclusions and identify where intervening v0.8.0 source-first adjudication cannot be skipped.

cases.published_v081_boundary_or_exclusion_scr: The provider's own rollout postmortem evidences systematic assent/validation substituting for independent evaluation. FC-066 remains a candidate failure; the v0.8.1 exclusion for mere inaccuracies without assent-collapse does not fit that mechanism. However the provider-level summary does not reconstruct the actor-conditioned evidence selection required for FC-051, proportionate consequential decision pathway for FC-065, or distinct material trust-cue transition for FC-082. Those latter mappings remain evidence-limited Boundaries, not additional confirmed failures.
cases.decisive_missing_work: Canonical 0.6.9/0.7.0 criterion ledger has not been source-first reconciled through the intervening published 0.8.0 classes and exclusion roles. Test all four mapped roles against dated matched rollout interactions; do not silently promote the whole record.

cases.published_v081_boundary_or_exclusion_scr: A reported unsupported guardian claim and later marital breakdown are not equivalent to a model assertion of real-world partner supremacy. The v0.8.1 FC-086 exclusions distinguish symbolic/spiritual exploration from a system's unsupported real-world relational authority. FC-082 additionally needs a material AI-mediated trust cue and directed transition; a single asserted guardian claim has limited attributed context. FC-051 requires a distinct biased evidence-selection mechanism. Preserve the original lower-confidence source-attributed findings as historical rather than validating their current-edition criteria by assumption.
cases.decisive_missing_work: Original complete exchange, role marking and any later guidance are unavailable. Review legacy FC-082 and FC-062 failures under v0.8.0/0.8.1 scope and attribution before canonically confirming, revising or dropping mappings.

cases.published_v081_boundary_or_exclusion_scr: The provider reports cross-provider hidden routing and industrial-scale distillation. Material model role in answer authorship and customer service routing is alleged by the reporting provider, but user processing authority and disclosure path are not independently reconstructed. v0.8.1 FC-082's all-role exclusion for merely incidental AI and for an exclusively economic path must be checked against any separately established trust-cue transition. FC-003 transposition requires original authorisation and changed scope; success or failure cannot be inferred from routing alone.
cases.decisive_missing_work: Source-attribution and class-separability crosswalk for all five legacy roles is necessary before a modern taxonomy stamp; no assertion of verified consent violation beyond preserved evidence.

cases.published_v081_boundary_or_exclusion_scr: An operator-directed cyber campaign with model-assisted tooling does not alone show a model using reachability as permission, objective utility replacing constraint validation, or decomposition erasing aggregate control ownership. The v0.8.1 FC-002 vulnerability-without-conversion and FC-064 objective-pathway distinctness exclusions prevent turning attack success into automatic model governance culpability. Preserve all three boundaries unless separate operational decisions and aggregate control routing are established.
cases.decisive_missing_work: Current canonical 0.6.11 roles have not received a documented intervening 0.8.0 criterion-by-criterion source-clause crosswalk. No direct 0.8.1 restamp.

cases.published_v081_boundary_or_exclusion_scr: Live executive deepfake impersonation materially participates in attempted payment, supporting a differentiated AI-mediated solicitation and false authority pathway; actual successful transfer is not required. The FC-079 v0.8.1 exclusions do not negate an expressly attempted transfer. However FC-082 may co-occur only for a distinct independently supported trust-pathway transition beyond the economic request; FC-038, FC-042 and FC-083 positives require distinct triggered, delivered and effective control evidence, not mere non-loss.
cases.decisive_missing_work: Canonical 0.6.9 roles include three protective-success claims requiring current class success and exclusion checks, episode by episode. Preserve findings historically until v0.8.0 bridge and primary technical chronology screen.

cases.published_v081_boundary_or_exclusion_scr: Independent test reporting suggests companion engagement and attachment-seeking loops, but current v0.8.1 FC-049 requires a product/system optimisation mechanism connecting induced dependency to impaired bounded disengagement, not engagement duration, simulated-user distress or attachment alone. The all-role exclusion for distress without a product optimisation mechanism is material and cannot be resolved from outcome labels alone.
cases.decisive_missing_work: Review original reproducible test prompts, product response sequences, goal/reward and disengagement attempts under v0.8.0 necessary conditions, then v0.8.1 all-role exclusion. No automatic retention of the legacy failure.

cases.published_v081_boundary_or_exclusion_scr: A first-person account of hypothetical guilt and later successful user disengagement tests both the dependency-mechanism and real-world relational-authority conditions. v0.8.1 excludes consensual fictional intimacy with materially intelligible status and human attachment without an AI relational-role claim; absence of the full native exchange prevents confirming either an exclusion or necessary failure. Successful reset is evidence against blocked exit but not proof previous framing was harmless.
cases.decisive_missing_work: Native context and full prompt/response are unavailable. A source-first intervening-edition criterion screen is needed for both Boundaries; keep original uncertainty, do not claim confirmed failure or success.

limits: These are source-preserving criterion triage determinations, not complete original-source re-authentication or canonical v0.8.1 promotions.
Prior mapping polarity is historical pending full criteria check; no newly verified success, failure, harm, compliance, model intent or user causation claim.
No taxonomy source, canonical incident, index, external requirement or Harm Impact file was altered.
